notes: CNN row = frozen isotonic calibrator; csi/pod/far at the val-frozen calibrated cut 0.1818 (operating_point.json, picked on val). Baselines use the spec cut 0.5 for csi/pod/far; 'tornado.cnn_raw' is the uncalibrated CNN (reported as a baseline-kind row for transparency only; it is not a separate model).

Primary auc_tor_vs_warned_null = ROC-AUC on TOR chips vs warned-null (WRN) chips only (TORN-07); day-block bootstrap over UTC calendar days of the chips (id days from splits/tornet.json); other metrics bootstrapped: auc, auprc, csi; pod/far/brier/ece/auc_range_* are point estimates (nan bounds).
Reference row: TorNet published AUC 0.874 is a different task/protocol (all chips, own test split), not directly comparable to the warned-null AUC; compare against 'auc' instead.
No tornado no-range checkpoint exists in models/, so the required-if-present ablation is omitted; tornado.range_only quantifies the range shortcut.
GBM and range-only logistic are fit on train only (87 all-missing train chips dropped, as in val_eval).
ECE of the calibrated CNN on val is ~0 because the isotonic map was fit on val (optimistic by design); on test it is a genuine out-of-sample calibration error.
Test chips from 2019-05-17..19 quarantine days are test-only by construction (SPLIT-08); case_holdout is limited to near-KTLX chips and is a small set (single-class AUC gives nan).
